projects.title: Investiture Ceremony
projects.subtitle: Ceremonial protocol shoot and documentary post-production.
projects.description: Ārohana handled the ceremonial shoot, protocol direction, and rapid post-production for the prestigious Western Command Investiture Ceremony in February 2026.
projects.scopeOfWork: Coverage of formal investiture protocols, honors and gallantry awards distribution, parade sequences, and master post-production.
projects.creativeApproach: Restrained, dignified visual pacing tailored to military protocol and ceremonial integrity.
projects.productionDiscipline: Tight turnaround master post-production with multi-track sound engineering and high-definition broadcast mastering.

projects.title: Communication & Production
projects.subtitle: High-altitude visual communication, films and archival design.
projects.description: Ārohana has undertaken communication, design and visual production work for 14 Corps Headquarters, including visual campaigns, Women's Day Nari Shakti initiatives, and First Villages outreach across remote border regions.
projects.scopeOfWork: Institutional communications campaigns, internal and public-facing visual communication, photo documentation, and community hygiene initiatives.
projects.creativeApproach: Authentic high-altitude cinematography paired with authoritative scripting and professional narration.
projects.productionDiscipline: Field documentation in sub-zero and remote mountain environments requiring specialised equipment and acclimatised crews.

projects.title: Corps-Level Communication & Publications
projects.subtitle: XIV Corps communication, publications, civil-military partnership and community initiatives.
projects.description: Fire & Fury Corps is the designation associated with XIV Corps. Ārohana has undertaken project work across communication, publications, photo documentation, and community-facing initiatives — from all-weather civil-military partnerships to tourism bridging programs.
projects.scopeOfWork: Spans historical commemorative literature, community welfare communication, hospitality bridging programs, and editorial photo production.
projects.creativeApproach: Balancing historical gravitas with contemporary digital readability across diverse audiences.
projects.productionDiscipline: Seamless integration between on-ground research, military history curation, and modern typography.

projects.title: Rezang La War Memorial
projects.subtitle: Commemorative coffee-table book design, visual communication and tribute documentation.
projects.description: Coffee-table book design, visual communication, and tribute photo documentation for the Rezang La War Memorial, honoring the 114 gallant soldiers who made the supreme sacrifice in the 1962 Battle of Rezang La.
projects.scopeOfWork: Complete publication design including hardbound cover architecture, typographic systems, archival photo restoration, and on-location memorial documentation.
projects.creativeApproach: Subtle, dignified layout allowing historical accounts, family tributes, and veteran testimonies to stand out with gravitas.
projects.productionDiscipline: High-specification tactile print finishing, custom clothbound styling, and museum-grade archival reproduction.
